entities.name: Gottfrid Billing

entities.summary: Axel Gottfrid Leonard Billing was a Swedish cleric and theologian who served as a member of the Swedish Academy, member of the Första kammaren in the Riksdag and Bishop of Lund from 1898 until 1925.
